_comment: ÐMP List Operation — Full example with PSDT and royalty
_doc: A list op declares the owner's intent to sell inscription_id at price koinu. The op must be inscribed in a transaction that spends the UTXO holding inscription_id (proving seller controls the asset). The psdt field is an unsigned or partially-signed PSDT that any buyer can complete atomically.
_price_note: 500,000 DOGE expressed in koinu (1 DOGE = 100,000,000 koinu). Always a string to avoid floating-point precision loss.
_royalty_note: 500 bps = 5% royalty. Max allowed is 1000 bps (10%). Royalty is paid by buyer on top of price, or split from price — marketplace convention applies.
_collection_note: Optional. Links this listing to the collection manifest for display purposes.
_expiry_note: Unix timestamp. Indexers treat this listing as expired after this time even if UTXO is unspent.
_psdt_note: Partially Signed Dogecoin Transaction. The seller has signed their input (the inscription UTXO). A buyer completes it by adding their payment input and broadcasting. Omit this field for OTC/manual settlement flows.
_indexer_checks: Verify the list tx spent the UTXO holding inscription_id
Verify seller is the address that held inscription_id at list time
Check expiry — mark expired if current time > expiry
Monitor inscription_id UTXO — auto-invalidate when spent
If a newer list op exists for the same inscription_id, supersede this one
